[[Poti]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] | capacity = 6,000 | chairman = Zaza Inashvili | manager = [[Revaz Gotsiridze]] | league = [[Erovnuli Liga 2]] | season = [[2025 Erovnuli Liga|2025]] | position = 10th of 10, Erovnuli Liga (relegated) | website = {{URL|kolkheti1913.ge}} | pattern_la1 = _macronalioth22rbw | pattern_b1 = _macronalioth22rbw | pattern_ra1 = _macronalioth22rbw | pattern_sh1 = _macrontempel1rbw | leftarm1 = 0000FF | body1 = 0000FF | rightarm1 = 0000FF | shorts1 = 0000FF | socks1 = 0000FF | pattern_la2 = _macronalioth22wrb | pattern_b2 = _macronalioth22wrb | pattern_ra2 = _macronalioth22wrb | pattern_sh2 = _macrontempel1wrb | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = _macrontureis21yrb | pattern_b3 = _macrontureis21yrb | pattern_ra3 = _macrontureis21yrb | pattern_sh3 = _macrontempel1by | pattern_so3 = _macronhoops18by | leftarm3 = FFFFFF | body3 = FFFFFF | rightarm3 = FFFFFF | shorts3 = FFFFFF | socks3 = 0000FF }} '''FC Kolkheti 1913''', commonly referred to as Kolkheti Poti, is a [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[association football|football]] club based in [[Poti]]. Following the [[2025 Erovnuli Liga 2|2025 season]], the team was relegated to the [[Erovnuli Liga 2]], the 2nd division of [[Football in Georgia (country)|Georgian football]]. Being registered in 1913, Kolkheti is the oldest active football club in the country.{{cite book |title=Georgia - List of Foundation Dates |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesg/georfound.html}} They are the two-time winners of the Soviet republican championship. After an independent [[Umaglesi Liga]] was formed in 1990, Kolkheti joined it as a 3rd-tier club{{cite web |title=ფრაგმენტები ისტორიიდან. 30 წლის წინათ |trans-title=Extracts from history: What happened 30 years ago |url=https://lelo.ge/article/ფრაგმენტები-ისტორიიდან-30-წლის-წინათ-21761 |website=lelo.ge |language=KA |date=27 March 2020 |access-date=9 April 2025}} and subsequently spent 17 successive seasons before worsening financial problems resulted in their first relegation. As the club's decline continued, it dropped into the third division by 2020. Kolkheti had two unsuccessful playoff campaigns in [[Liga 3 (Georgia)|Liga 3]] before securing two consecutive promotions. Their first European tie was against Serbian club [[FK Zemun|Zemun]] in 1996.{{cite web |title=Kolkheti 1913 vs Zemun match report |url=https://www.worldfootball.net/match-report/ma2127682/lineup/ |website=worldfootball.net |date=29 June 1996}} The club plays its home games at [[Fazisi Stadium]]."}}
